title: ErrorBody
description: The body of every error answer of the three routes: a stable code, and for resync_required the account's current cursor. 401 answers carry WWW-Authenticate: Bearer; 429 answers carry Retry-After (seconds). Readers must tolerate a code they do not know.

error.description: 422 invalid_request, 404 not_found, 409 resync_required, 401 invalid_token, token_unknown, token_expired or token_revoked, 429 too_many_requests, 500 internal_error.
